notes: Final per-slot scores = J1 where J1 = J2, else ADJ (scripts/52 rule); reconstruction asserted equal to analysis_main_genes.tsv. Term-only: the three real +1s that the manuscript's Table 2 'Basis' column marks as module-only (YPEL5, DPCD, WDR7; read from judge justifications) set to 0; every supported decoy's justification names the process (term) -> unchanged. Term vs module was not re-judged blind.

Slot permutation: real slot uniform over the 4 slots within each gene, statistic = Σ(real − mean of the other three), exact convolution. Module-clustered: d averaged within genes sharing the real statement's V1′ label, exact sign-flip over cluster means.
